# NT/TSF Employee SOP
This Standard Operating Procedure is to help guide NanoTrasen and TSF personnel serving aboard VTS stations.
These personnel are considered part of the crew while aboard the station, but they are not employed directly by VTS station command. They hold no official command authority outside of what is explicitly stated in their SOP, their assigned role, or direct authorization from VTS Central Command, NanoTrasen, or the TSF.
NT and TSF employees are expected to support station operations, follow Space Law and VTS guidelines, and cooperate with station command where appropriate.
